sections.title: Get latest stats for all shards
sections.text:
GET /v1/shards/stats/last

Get most recent statistics for all shards.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_all_shard_stats](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_all_shard_stats) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/shards/stats/last?interval=1sec&stime=015-05-27T08:27:35Z 


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| interval | string | Time interval for which we want stats: 1sec/10sec/5min/15min/1hour/12hour/1week. Default: 1sec (optional) |
| stime | ISO_8601 | Start time from which we want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (optional) |
| etime | ISO_8601 | End time after which we don't want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (optional) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns most recent [statistics](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/statistics) for all shards.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#name-200-ok) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#name-404-not-found) | No shards exist |

sections.title: Get latest shard stats
sections.text:
GET /v1/shards/stats/last/{int: uid}

Get most recent statistics for a specific shard.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_shard_stats](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_shard_stats) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/shards/stats/last/1?interval=1sec&stime=2015-05-28T08:27:35Z 


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the shard requested. |


#### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| interval | string | Time interval for which we want stats: 1sec/10sec/5min/15min/1hour/12hour/1week. Default: 1sec. (optional) |
| stime | ISO_8601 | Start time from which we want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (optional) |
| etime | ISO_8601 | End time after which we don't want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (optional) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns the most recent [statistics](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/statistics) for the specified shard.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#name-200-ok) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#name-404-not-found) | Shard does not exist |
| [406 Not Acceptable](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#name-406-not-acceptable) | Shard isn't currently active |
